column1: # A word budget for each prompt the pipeline puts in a model's context (#201). Read by
# scripts/prompt-budget.sh, which `make check` runs. Each budget is the file's size when the
# budget was set (rounded up to 50 words), so growth shows up as a warning in `make check`.
# Lower a budget when a file shrinks; raise one only with a reason in the PR.
# Columns, tab-separated: file, budget in words (rule markers, `<!-- rule: … -->`, don't count).
